title: Require Domain Model Data Owner Shape
forbids: domain model data files outside their exact named-corpus dependency, import-source, re-export, and non-authority shape
why: Domain model data owns named reference corpora and pure derivations, not schema construction, structural validation, artifact admission, operation envelopes, or stage authoring. Source-level authority rejects authoring and validation packages regardless of aliases while preserving type-only schema and runtime policy dependencies.
remediate: Keep named reference corpora and pure derivations in model/data/<collection>, keep relative dependencies inside the sibling corpus, owning policy surface, and type-only schema surface, and move schema construction, structural validation, artifact, operation, recipe, or stage concerns to their owner.
message: Domain model data files must remain named corpus data without artifact, operation, recipe, or stage authority.
